recommendation: Keep the audit commit and do not reintroduce the extension definition into core. Future changes to the QuestionnaireResponse attester extension, including broader context or alignment with later Composition attester modeling, should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions after a final work-group decision.
issue_request: Published / Not Persuasive with Modification R5 request to define a standard QuestionnaireResponse attester extension, rather than a native QuestionnaireResponse element, mirroring Composition.attester-style attestation information and exposing it in SDC as optional.
initial_application: Core commit 53bb3c4c23 added source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-extension-questionnaireresponse-attester.xml and referenced it from the QuestionnaireResponse core implementation guide; the Jira comment records that commit as the core application.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f17 later removed standard extension definitions from R5 core source as part of the Extension Pack split. Current core source has no questionnaireresponse-attester StructureDefinition and only retains the OID mapping. The active definition is in HL7/fhir-extensions and is published by the Extension Pack CI build. Later FHIR-55803 resolved no-change for removing Device from the extension, supporting that QuestionnaireResponse attestation may intentionally differ from document attestation; FHIR-55801 remains unresolved for possible broader/generic attester work.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source was changed because the requested artifact already exists and current source ownership is outside this checkout.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - No Change decision confirms Device may remain allowed for QuestionnaireResponse attestation because software/AI-populated forms differ from document attestation.
Triaged and unresolved request to make the attester extension more generic and available on DocumentReference; not final and not decided here.
Published Composition-only change made Composition.attester.mode CodeableConcept/preferred for R5; it did not directly decide the QuestionnaireResponse extension.
FHIR-extensions punctuation cleanup for the QuestionnaireResponse attester extension confirms active Extension Pack maintenance.
